framework.name: MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise)
framework.disclaimer: CSW mitigation/detection coverage for adversary techniques, NOT a control attestation.

controls.intent: Remote Services (lateral movement) — micro-segmentation restricts which hosts can reach remote-access services.
controls.note: Mitigation (M1030 network segmentation); coverage = enforcement breadth, not rule correctness.

controls.intent: Exploitation of Remote Services — segmentation limits reachable vulnerable services.
Lateral Tool Transfer — workload enforcement blocks unauthorized transfer paths.
External Remote Services — segmentation controls external-to-internal access paths.
Trusted Relationship — segmentation constrains lateral reach from trusted third-party connections.
Network Service Discovery — flow telemetry surfaces scanning/enumeration activity.
controls.note: Detection coverage: CSW provides flow visibility, not signature-based IDS.

controls.intent: Remote System Discovery — flow telemetry reveals host-enumeration traffic.
Application Layer Protocol (C2) — flow telemetry exposes command-and-control channels.
Exfiltration Over C2 Channel — flow telemetry exposes outbound exfil over the C2 path.
Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol — flow telemetry surfaces anomalous egress.
Proxy — flow telemetry surfaces relayed/proxied traffic patterns.
Protocol Tunneling — flow telemetry surfaces tunneled traffic.
Process Discovery — CSW agents provide process-level telemetry on the host.
controls.note: Coverage = agent presence; CSW reports process inventory where agents are healthy.
Email/user vector — outside CSW's network/workload reach.

controls.intent: Valid Accounts — abuse of legitimate credentials.
controls.note: Identity/credential control — CSW is not an IdP. (Segmentation limits blast radius but does not address the technique.)

controls.intent: Brute Force — credential guessing against authentication.
Command and Scripting Interpreter — on-host code execution.
controls.note: Host execution/EDR concern — outside CSW's network-segmentation reach.

controls.intent: Data Encrypted for Impact (ransomware encryption) — destructive on-host action.
controls.note: On-host impact — CSW does not prevent local encryption.
